children: Cantor Fitzgerald maintained their Overweight rating on Western Digital's stock with a price target of $625.00.
The price target implies an upside of 76.5% from the Oct 22 close of $354.19.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Western Digital demonstrated impressive financial performance, posting a revenue of $4.38 billion, which exceeded both expectations and consensus estimates. The company also provided a robust revenue guidance of $5.10 billion for the upcoming quarter, reflecting a significant year-over-year increase and indicating strong demand and pricing expansion in the HDD market.
High Gross Margins and Positive Pricing Power

: The company reported gross margins of 58.1%, which surpassed consensus expectations, and guided for even higher margins of 60.5% in the next quarter. This improvement is attributed to favorable pricing dynamics and a shift towards higher-capacity, high-value solutions, suggesting that Western Digital is well-positioned to maintain profitability and leverage its pricing power in the market.
